```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# load our data
lithic_data <- read_csv("lithics_raw.csv")

# clean the data
lithic_data_clean <-
lithic_data |> # 'then' cmd + shift + m
  mutate(length_m = parse_number(length_mm)) |>
  mutate(platform_mm = parse_number(platform_mm))
```
